name: Earthquake at the Volcano Approach

npcs.name: Rico Dela Cruz
dialogue: Typhoon winds, floodwater, and unstable slopes are already dangerous. Now tremors and ashfall begin.
Take cover during shaking, then follow the official inland route. Avoid valleys and slopes.
after_dialogue: The group is clear of the valley. Keep masks on and listen for the next official update.

choice.prompt: Ash is spreading and evacuation orders are active. What now?

options.text: Follow official routes and protect eyes and breathing
options.result: Residents leave the hazard zone with suitable protection.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.text: Wait near the valley for a clearer view
options.result: Ash, gases, and lahars make the valley unsafe.
options.consequence: You remained in the volcanic hazard zone.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Dr. Mira Santos
dialogue: I helped the harbor families escape. Now a tremor has blocked our path, and ash hides the road.
Bring the radio so I can call the team. Then carry me along the marked route.
after_dialogue: The team heard us. Please keep me away from the valley and falling rocks.
rescue_dialogue: I cannot walk safely with my injured leg. Bring the emergency radio, then carry me to the safe route, away from smoke and ash.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. Please carry me to the safe route, away from smoke and ash.
npcs.rescue_hint: Collect the emergency radio, then speak with Dr. Mira Santos again.

quests.title: Help Dr. Mira Santos call the response team
Check in with Rico Dela Cruz
Find eye protection before crossing the ash and debris route.
Find Protective mask for the response team

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.rescue_pilar: Find Dr. Mira Santos and give her the radio so she can call the response team.
quests.community: Find Rico Dela Cruz and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach the marked inland safe zone.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Follow current PHIVOLCS and local authority alerts and evacuation orders.
Keep outside restricted danger zones; use a protective mask or wet cloth if ashfall occurs.
Avoid river channels that may carry lahar during intense rain.

quiz.question: Authorities order evacuation from a volcanic danger zone. What is safest?
options: Leave using the designated route and follow official instructions
Wait until ash or rocks are visible
Travel into a river channel to find another route
quiz.explanation: Follow PHIVOLCS and local authority evacuation orders; avoid restricted zones and hazardous channels.

briefing: An earthquake damages roads toward the volcanic region. After the shaking, an eruption triggers evacuation alerts. Follow official instructions, avoid restricted zones and valleys threatened by lahars, and use suitable eye and respiratory protection from ash.
story_clue: Dr. Voss’s recording warns that an uncontrolled shutdown could release catastrophic energy.
